scope: Primary task-definition triage, not new candidate or GPU run. No scores, optimizer, downloads or dataset relabeling.

sources.read_scope: Abstract and targeted indexed primary-text excerpts only. Later full-page requests encountered publisher redirect / PMC recaptcha; no claim of complete reading.
supported_facts: The image task includes anatomical landmarks and pathological findings.
Ulcerative-colitis labels include grades and intermediate categories; authors discuss observer variation.
Upper/lower GI and finding-type structure are described by the original dataset.
limits: A shared family is not a new independent image.
Do not merge targets or infer patient-level independence.
Do not use the displayed paper count table to remap labels; retain existing verified manifest order/counts.

next_question: For saved R84 UC-family mistakes, is the wrong label usually inside or outside that family? Coarse-family supervision cannot by itself resolve within-family leaf errors.
secondary_scope: All members of all three explicitly named families, both existing balanced/natural heads; no selector or new outcome metric.
